sloka: दीयमानां न तु तदा प्रतिजग्राह राघव: ।अविज्ञाय पितुश्छन्दमयोध्याधिपते: प्रभो: ॥ २.११८.५१॥
transliteration: dīyamānāṁ na tu tadā pratijagrāha rāghava: ।avijñāya pituśchandamayodhyādhipate: prabho: ॥ 2.118.51॥

translations.english: Then Rama did not accept the offer of my father straightaway before he knew the opinion of his father Dasaratha, king of Ayodhya.
